report.summary: CONTENT seam fixed and proven through the real client. The bench path already existed (poh_workshop_functions.rs2 [oploc1,poh_clockmaking_3] -> Clockwork / Clockwork toys -> Clockwork penguin, gated on peng_quest>=25), but NO player-owned house could render a room: since 37f8b2a84 (2026-09-20, SSC_SYM_DBROW became its own symbol kind sorting after OBJ) every bare POH room/furniture name in an untyped position compiles to the same-named OBJ id (poh_dummy_garden -> obj 8415, whose dbrow-id 8415 is sailing_customisation_tab_sail), so the starter house stored obj ids as room rows and ~poh_place_rooms/~poh_restore_decorations read sailing rows -- the house was bare grass. Fix: [proc,poh_row](dbrow $row)(dbrow) in poh_state.rs2 (a dbrow-typed proc parameter is a typed position for the compiler's param_kinds hint), used for the two starter rooms (poh_state.rs2) and all 32 room comparisons in ~poh_restore_decorations (poh_construct.rs2); saves now store 4167/4166/4177. Plus a prerequisite-staging cheat ::coldwarpoh (coldwar_debug.rs2): Rimmington house + Workshop east of the Parlour (laid out as ~poh_build_room_from_door would) + Crafting table 3 in the crafting-table slot (recorded as ~poh_build_single would), player left at the Rimmington portal. Source: Quest Helper ColdWar.java enterPoh 'Travel to your POH or another POH with a Crafting table 3 or 4' + general requirement Construction 34; docs/quests/cold_war.md section 2 'Additional access: Crafting table 3 or 4'; the table itself is Construction training (table 3 is an upgrade of table 2, 2 molten glass, all.dbrow poh_crafting_table_3), not a Cold War step, so it is staged like a skill level while the guide's three steps (enterPoh, makeClockwork, makePenguin) are driven by clicks. Ambiguous-name warnings 1277 -> 1240.

SYSTEMIC, not fixed: the obj/dbrow bare-name collision still miscompiles ~690 other POH sites (poh_build.rs2 268, poh_trophies 100, poh_hall 48, poh_rooms.rs2 add-room selection 33 -> a room BUILT through the interface still stores an obj id, ...) and 160 dbrow sites outside skill_construction; `SSCOMPILE_AMBIGUOUS=all make -C src torirsserver-scripts` lists them. needs: src/serverscript/ssc_compile.c: give SSC_Local the declared type's symbol kind, use it as arg_kind_hint for def_<type> initialisers and single-target assignments, set last_value_kind on a local read, and hint return(...) from the proc's declared return types -- then `def_dbrow $r = poh_room_get(...)` comparisons and dbrow-returning procs resolve without ~poh_row.
Saves written by the broken pack carry obj ids in [poh_rooms] (8415/8395/...); no migration was added (no source says what such a save should become); a fresh character is unaffected.

Assigned path server/scripts/poh/ does not exist; the POH scripts are skill_construction/scripts/poh_*.rs2 (where the triage's poh_workshop_functions.rs2 lives) -- I edited poh_state.rs2 and poh_construct.rs2 there; no concurrent seam owns them.
